Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Studio Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and interactive style selectors. (why: Adoption has a steep 39.1% dropoff and high median time (89s), plus 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected appearances.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Onboarding Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive guide screen right after home_intro demonstrating how to summon, drag, hide, and talk to the pet on the desktop. (why: Multiple support emails (3 emails) specifically asked how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Placement: Reorders the sign-in step to happen right after pet adoption completion so users bind their newly created pet directly to their account. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, indicating confusion around account creation before pet setup.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Screen Experience: Transforms the background rendering wait into an interactive mini-story screen where users answer personality questions to shape their pet's traits while waiting. (why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean wait time of 2336s (median 201s), causing high dropoff before onboarding completes.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines & Quality Hint: Adds visual photo quality guidelines and tip callouts on upload_photos screen to prevent broken custom pet generation. (why: Users reported 3 bugs related to custom pet generation failing or looking distorted.)
5: [home, wait_info] Render Status Detailed Progress Bar: Displays estimated render time breakdown, progress percentage, and background completion notification options on the waiting screen. (why: Home stage has long duration (mean 2336s / median 201s), leaving users unsure if the app is stuck.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Reassurance Banner: Adds prominent messaging reassuring users that their selected pet configuration is linked securely and will not be lost upon sign in. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in.)
